note: Shoshone NF (Wapiti RD) campground in lodgepole pine on the North Fork of the Shoshone River, ~3 mi from Yellowstone's east entrance and ~50 mi W of Cody. Hard-sided RVs and campers only (no tents or pop-ups: grizzly area); bear boxes at the sites. --Claude
summary: FS and rec.gov current. 21 sites (8 reservable on rec.gov, 13 first-come), $20 (double $40), 16-day limit, May 16 - Sep 20 2027, hard-sided only, Senior/Access 50%. Stored booking 'not reservable / always' -> reservable / some_sites per rec.gov. Riverview stands (stream ~20 m wide; creekside lead at site 012 only). Phone empty -> (307) 527-6921.
flags: WATERFRONT (checked hard): 'riverview' stands. The North Fork at the campground is ~18-22 m of open water at summer flow (gravel bars either side), so any on-water value would be creekside, not riverfront. Nearest sites: 012 (44.49619,-109.95173, first-come) ~15-20 m from the water across a gravel bank with a few conifers between - a borderline creekside LEAD for one site only; 010 (44.49664,-109.95279) ~15 m from the west bend but behind dense conifers; 016 (44.49605,-109.94969) ~35 m behind a tree band. rec.gov: 'Some sites overlook the river'. No upgrade proposed; riverview is the view value for a stream (there is no creek-view value).

POLICY/BOOKING CONTRADICTION: the FS page says 'This site is first come, first served.' (and 'Sites may be reservable'); rec.gov's catalog sells 001-004 and 017-020 with a 2-day cutoff. Written reservable/some_sites per rec.gov (stored reservable false / fcfs always was from the sweep note).
